test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 4335pi cm², and the diameter of its base is 102 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify **Radius (r)** = 102 ÷ 2 = 51 cm.

Using **CSA** = πrl ⇒ 4335π = π × 51 × l ⇒ **Slant height (l)** = 85 cm.

Apply **Pythagorean Triplet** (8, 15, 17) scaled by 5 × 17 = 85, 3 × 17 = 51, 4 × 17 = 68.

**∴ The height is 68 cm.**

**∴ The correct answer is 68 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 4335π cm², **Diameter (d)** = 102 cm.

**Formula Used:** CSA = πrl and l² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d286b87fa8dd42c5d814700663b43a21156a1aaae5806036b8fbb3e14d032b06.png] 

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 102 ÷ 2 = 51 cm.

⇒ **π × r × l** = 4335π

⇒ 51 × l = 4335

⇒ l = 4335 ÷ 51 = 85 cm.

⇒ h² = l² − r²

⇒ h² = 85² − 51² = (85 − 51)(85 + 51)

⇒ h² = 34 × 136 = 4624

⇒ h = √4624 = 68 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 68 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area includes the **CSA** and the **Base Area**: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of Cone

The capacity of a cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Relation between l, r, and h

In a right circular cone, the slant height (l), vertical height (h), and radius (r) form a **Right-Angled Triangle**: l² = r² + h².</p
